description: Données routières du département is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil départemental du Cantal. Tonnage limitation on departmental roads. Coverage: Conseil départemental du Cantal. The portal shows the English title as "Road data from the department" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil départemental du Cantal. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLS, PDF, ZIP. The listing shows 2022-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
